messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up — GlobalFin wants a Dedicated POC with BYO HSM + offline key ceremony. They need FIPS L3 attestation and a documented rotation plan. Any blockers?

irene_solutions: Quick clarifiers: 1) BYO HSM (on-prem) or cloud HSM attach? 2) Require FIPS 140-2/3 L3 cert?

alex_sales: BYO (on-prem) preferred. They explicitly asked for midnight UTC rotation windows and zero downtime on rotation. Also asked about audit log delivery.

matt_infra: We support BYO via Private deployment + key-sync agent over secure tunnel. Offline ceremonies ok; we don't store raw key material — we keep references/aliases. Rotation can be orchestrated with no downtime if aliases are used and DEKs are cached.

matt_infra: Note: vendor specifics matter (exportable vs non-exportable keys). Need model/vendor and whether they will export wrapped key material or perform ceremony and share only wrapped keys.

security_bot: See https://redwood.dev/security/kms-hsm-integrations — supported vendors, network/port requirements, audit/export examples.

irene_solutions: Pricing estimate for BYO-HSM + Private: onboarding ~$15k (one-time), annual HSM support $8k-12k, plus Private licensing. I'll confirm precise quote.

alex_sales: Need a one-sentence answer for their compliance team: "Can Redwood support customer-managed HSM keys with rotation and audit logs?"

matt_infra: Draft: "Yes — Redwood Private integrates with customer HSMs (hardware-backed keys) over secure tunnels, supports offline key ceremonies, orchestrated rotation with alias-based cutover to avoid application downtime, and exports key operation logs to customer SIEMs."

irene_solutions: I'll attach a short appendix describing the handover & rotation flow.

irene_solutions: ```
Example key handover & rotation
- Customer generates keys inside FIPS L3 HSM and performs offline ceremony
- Customer provides public/wrapped key material or KEK-wrapped DEK to Redwood via secure transfer
- Key-sync agent stores key metadata and alias; no raw symmetric key stored in Redwood
- Rotation: schedule at 00:00 UTC; new key created in HSM, agent syncs new alias, old alias deprecated for N days
- Auditing: HSM events + Redwood access logs forwarded to customer SIEM (syslog/HTTP)
```

legal_ops: Reminder — do not promise key escrow; if customer requests escrow or exception, we need a signed addendum.

alex_sales: They also want throughput guidance: will HSM ops affect token latency at scale?

matt_infra: HSM sign/unwrap ops are higher latency (tens to hundreds ms). For high-QPS inference we recommend KEK-in-HSM with short-lived DEKs cached in software; use KV cache to avoid HSM per-token. Tradeoff: fewer HSM calls reduces latency/cost but increases key material exposure window.

irene_solutions: Action items:
- Matt: BYO HSM runbook (vendor, endpoints, ports, certs, sample syslog config) by EOD tomorrow
- Legal: CMK addendum template for escrow/exception
- Alex: gather customer's HSM vendor/model and whether they will export key material or run ceremony

matt_infra: I'll post the runbook draft here when ready (includes iptables/TLS snippets and sample syslog forward).

legal_ops: I'll prepare an addendum draft and DM for review.

alex_sales: Thanks — will loop in customer security. Please ack when documents are up. :rocket:

matt_infra: Ack.

legal_ops: Ack.
